task: P02-T3 slice 3 (#628): host-only serialized checkpoint coordinator model
summary: 43/100 unchanged. A host-only model exercises serialized authorization and revocation, exact candidate and freshness binding, revocable handles and explicit unknown-publication reconciliation. Existing Client commits do not yet require a durable pre-send checkpoint. Native wiring, trusted recovery custody and product acceptance remain open.
